name: SCYTHEBAT
source:
A lesbian, mixed-media/experimental visual novel about two girls running away from their past in a post-apocalyptic, zombie-infested world. Follow Maria and Lorelei through their time together and apart, slowly uncovering the reason why they are the way they are. 

[Edited from [url=https://bunibonbun.itch.io/scythebat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部女同性恋、混合媒体/实验视觉小说，讲述了两个女孩在僵尸横行的后世界末日世界中逃离过去的故事。跟随玛丽亚和罗蕾莱一起经历他们在一起和分开的时光，慢慢揭开他们为何成为现在这样的原因。

[编辑自[url=https://bunibonbun.itch.io/scythebat]itch.io[/url]]
